blind.description: A medieval pavise shield standing upright with an integrated rear wooden A-frame prop. The front face of the shield consists of vertical wooden planks split into two color halves—one red and one natural light wood—bound by a thick, dark iron-reinforced border with rivets. Behind the shield is a sturdy timber kickstand/support frame joined by iron bands and featuring a red padded backing or grip. Surfaces are clean, solid, and stylised in a hand-painted game-asset aesthetic with no cracks, holes, or detached geometry.
blind.from_above: From straight above, it resembles an angled roof-like chevron or V-profile: the curved top ridge of the shield with dark metal trim, red and light wood faces sloping down, and wooden support legs extending outward behind it.
blind.height_vs_figure: About 2.5 to 3 feet tall (roughly half the height of the 5 ft 9 in reference figure) and approximately 1.5 to 2 feet wide.
